(16 April) |prevseason=[[2022 Liga 1 (Peru)|2022]] |nextseason=[[2024 Liga 1 (Peru)|2024]] }} The '''2023 Liga 1 de Fútbol Profesional''' (known as the '''Liga 1 Betsson 2023''' for sponsorship reasons) was the 107th season of the [[Peruvian Primera División]], the highest division of [[Peru]]vian [[Association football|football]]. A total of 19 teams competed in the season, which began on 3 February and ended on 8 November 2023. The season was originally scheduled to begin on 21 January, but the first two matchdays were postponed due to the [[2022–2023 Peruvian protests]].{{cite web|url=https://libero.pe/futbol-peruano/liga-1/2023/01/26/liga-1-segunda-fecha-se-jugara-sera-reprogramada-debido-problemas-sociales-256488|title=Liga 1: se posterga la segunda fecha y será reprogramada por la coyuntura social|trans-title=Liga 1: the second matchday is postponed and will be rescheduled due to the social situation|publisher=Líbero|language=es|date=26 January 2023|access-date=26 January 2023}} The fixtures for the season were announced on 30 December 2022.{{cite web|url=https://www.infobae.com/america/peru/2022/12/30/sorteo-liga-1-2023-en-vivo-golperu-fpf-play-directv-fixture-alianza-universitario-cristal/|title=Liga 1 2023: fixture y partidos del torneo peruano|trans-title=2023 Liga 1: fixture and matches of the Peruvian tournament|publisher=Infobae|language=es|date=30 December 2022|access-date=3 January 2023}} [[Club Universitario de Deportes|Universitario]] were the champions, winning their twenty-seventh league title after defeating [[Club Alianza Lima|Alianza Lima]] in the two-legged final with a 3–1 aggregate score.{{cite web|url=https://depor.com/futbol-peruano/descentralizado/alianza-lima-vs-universitario-de-deportes-en-vivo-en-directo-via-liga-1-max-online-fecha-hora-y-canal-para-ver-final-de-vuelta-liga-1-betsson-transmision-gratis-futbol-libre-directv-go-claro-tv-deportes-noticia/|title=¡Matutazo! Universitario venció 2-0 a Alianza Lima y es el campeón de la Liga 1 Betsson|trans-title=''[[Estadio Alejandro Villanueva|Matute]]'' smash! Universitario beat Alianza Lima 2–0 and are the Liga 1 Betsson champions|publisher=Depor|language=es|date=8 November 2023|access-date=8 November 2023}} Alianza Lima were the defending champions, having won back-to-back titles in [[2021 Liga 1 (Peru)|2021]] and [[2022 Liga 1 (Peru)|2022]]. ==Teams== 19 teams took part in the league in this season: the top 16 teams from the [[2022 Liga 1 (Peru)|2022 tournament]], plus the [[2022 Copa Perú]] champions [[Deportivo Garcilaso]], the [[2022 Liga 2 (Peru)|Liga 2]] champions [[Cusco FC|Cusco]] and [[Unión Comercio]], the winners of the [[2022 Liga 1 (Peru)#Relegation playoff|promotion/relegation]] play-off.
